scoring_justification: Implementing a full state-space solver in the checker is infeasible; structural validation of stress reduction trend and magnitude ensures the main claim is verified.

outputs.description: Maximum peel and shear stresses in the adhesive layer for Case 1 under two electric-field conditions (0 and -500 V/mm).

output_contract.notes: The solver must implement the FOST state-space model as described; the scoring reference is computed independently by the checker using the same material and geometric parameters.

steps.description: Verify that the reported peak peel and shear stresses exhibit the expected reduction under negative electric field.
